title: Cottage Garden: Coloring Book for Adults and Teens, Bold and Easy
subtitle: 50 Cozy English Garden Designs Featuring Roses, Stone Paths, Picket Fences, and Charming Cottages for Relaxation
description:
Wander through blooming English cottage gardens overflowing with roses, lavender, and old-world charm.


This coloring book brings the timeless beauty of English cottage gardens to your fingertips. Each page features lovingly illustrated scenes of climbing roses on stone walls, winding garden paths, quaint potting sheds, birdbaths among wildflowers, and charming thatched-roof cottages surrounded by lush borders. Every design is drawn with bold, easy-to-color outlines and a warm, cozy aesthetic.

What's Inside:
• 50 unique English cottage garden illustrations with thick, bold outlines
• Climbing roses, lavender fields, sunflower patches, wisteria arches, and herb gardens
• Stone cottages, garden gates, picket fences, potting sheds, and greenhouse scenes
• Single-sided pages to prevent bleed-through
• Large 8.5 x 8.5 inch pages for comfortable coloring
• Perfect for colored pencils, markers, and gel pens

Perfect For:
• Relaxation and peaceful creative time
• A lovely gift for gardeners and flower lovers
• Spring and summer vibes all year round
• All skill levels — beginners to experienced colorists

Grab your colors and step into a blooming English garden.
Let the flowers and sunshine carry you to a moment of joy.
